cpu: One Linux affinity core; OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL/NUMEXPR1; TIFF/Zarr worker1; no GPU.

cases.real640: Actual CT-derived baseline/reverse d9v2 maps, published w00 labels; HP/AUC/rows and combined file pipeline.
cases.public2560: 2560x2560 crop of official public2.403um map plus matching humanlabels; synthetic523-row rolled workload control. HP only; no depth-order validation.

measurements.hp_files: Entire warmed score_files call, including both TIFF loads, label reads/grid mapping, forward/control filters, masks/correlations/nulls/report return.
measurements.full_pipeline: real640 AUC(1000paired draws,107pxblocks)+HP+rows, eachwithfiles/control, no intertool cache; includes all reads/reports, no interpreter startup.
measurements.cli_process_wall_s: Fresh subprocess from immediately before launch until return: imports, all HP files/scoring, JSON stdout and process shutdown; no warmup.
measurements.worker_process_wall_s: Diagnostic whole worker process includes one warm pipeline, each timed operation, and repeat fullpipeline only for real640; not single CLI latency.
measurements.process_peak_rss_kib: Linux ru_maxrss for worker process including imports/warmup/alloperations, KiB; no incremental or per-function interpretation.
measurements.cli_peak_rss_kib: Linux ru_maxrss for cold HP CLI process, KiB; captures all imports and scoring.

parity: Every returned JSON field for all operation/control reports compared exactly to baseline reference; CLI parsed report too. All20variant rows retained. Rounding/statistics/schema unchanged.
summary: Ratio of medians and all pairedratios; five timings pervariant percase, no significance/generalwholecanvasclaim. Retain negative results and RSS.
implementation: Only per-call reuse of label-only highpass key/core; map coverage,inner,rollednullsupport independent. No globalcache.
limits: Existing nonfinite/invalid input behaviors not redefined; same supported numerical inputs. Bounded2560crop is not full305Mpixel canvas; syntheticcontrol not inference.
